name: San Martín de la Virgen de Moncayo (Spain)
description: Red field with a white and green dancetty stripe along the lower part, charged at the centre with a green arch bearing a yellow lyre, between a basket of fruit and an oak leaf.
history: Municipal flag of San Martín de la Virgen de Moncayo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: dancetty (zigzag) stripes of white and green along the lower part
arch at the centre edged yellow and oak leaf at the upper fly
lyre on the arch and basket of fruit at the upper hoist
